basic_details.job_title: ITDA Pakur Part Time Teacher Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 15 Posts
basic_details.short_information: Integrated Tribal Development Agency, Pakur (ITDA Pakur) has announced 15 vacancies for Part Time Teacher posts on a contractual basis under advertisement number 02/2026. Eligible candidates can apply offline by sending the filled application form along with self-attested copies of educational and experience certificates by registered or speed post to the Project Director, Integrated Tribal Development Agency, Pakur on or before 27 October 2026. rows.details: Integrated Tribal Development Agency, Pakur (ITDA Pakur)
Part Time Teacher (Hindi, Sanskrit, Mathematics, Science, History and Civics, Geography, Economics, Physical Teacher)

Graduation / Post Graduation with B.Ed / D.El.Ed as applicable per post and S-TET/C-TET qualification

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Candidates must send their fully filled application form along with self-attested copies of educational and other supporting experience certificates through registered post or speed post to the office of the Project Director, Integrated Tribal Development Agency, Pakur.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Educational Qualification Details: Graduate Trained Teacher (Class VI-VIII): Minimum 50% marks in graduation from a recognized institute along with a 4-year integrated B.Ed or 3-year graduation with Honours and B.Ed. Passing of CBSE-conducted S-TET/C-TET Paper-2 is mandatory. Intermediate Trained Teacher (Class I-V): Minimum 50% marks in 10+2 and D.El.Ed / D.Ed. Passing of CBSE-conducted S-TET/C-TET Paper-1 is mandatory. Category-wise Reservation (Intermediate Trained Teachers in Middle Schools): Unreserved: 02, Scheduled Tribe (ST): 02, Scheduled Caste (SC): 01, Extremely Backward Class (BC-1): 01, Economically Weaker Section (EWS): 01. content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is made on the basis of a merit list prepared according to academic qualifications and teaching experience. Initial engagement is for 06 months on a service procurement basis under a contractual arrangement, renewable for another 06 months based on satisfactory performance. Candidates belonging to the same village, panchayat, or blocks of Scheduled Tribe, Scheduled Castes, or Backward Classes with teaching experience will be given preference, and government reservation rules apply.

faq.question: Q1. Is this ITDA Pakur Part Time Teacher position permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: This is a temporary engagement on a service procurement / hourly basis for a period of 06 months, extendable for another 06 months upon satisfactory performance.

faq.question: Q2. Who receives preference in the selection process for these teaching posts?
faq.answer: Candidates belonging to the same village, panchayat, or blocks from Scheduled Tribe, Scheduled Caste, or Backward Classes who possess prior teaching experience are given preference during selection.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application and where should it be sent?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted offline by sending the fully filled form along with self-attested documents via registered or speed post to the office of the Project Director, Integrated Tribal Development Agency, Pakur.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form is 27 October 2026 up to 05:00 PM.
